issues.title: API domain completely unavailable (503 Service Unavailable)
issues.description: All endpoints on api.thenewfuse.com return HTTP 503. This includes /docs, /api/health, /api/auth/login, /api/v1/auth/login, and all other routes.
issues.impact: All API-dependent functionality broken; marketplace, auth, health checks non-functional

issues.title: Relay domain completely unavailable (503 Service Unavailable)
issues.description: All endpoints on relay.thenewfuse.com return HTTP 503. This affects WebSocket relay functionality.
issues.impact: WebSocket relay non-functional; real-time features broken

issues.title: Wildcard CORS (access-control-allow-origin: *)
issues.description: Main domain allows requests from any origin via wildcard CORS policy.
issues.impact: Any website can make credentialed requests to thenewfuse.com

issues.title: Wildcard CORS (access-control-allow-origin: *)
issues.description: App domain allows requests from any origin via wildcard CORS policy.
issues.impact: Any website can make credentialed requests to app.thenewfuse.com

issues.title: API docs endpoint returns 500 instead of 200
issues.description: Swagger/OpenAPI documentation endpoint returns server error instead of documentation.

issues.title: App health endpoint returns 503
issues.description: Health check endpoint on app domain returns service unavailable.

issues.title: Auth login endpoint returns 503 instead of 400
issues.description: POST /api/auth/login should return 400 on empty body (validation rejects), but returns 503.

issues.title: Auth v1 login endpoint returns 503 instead of 400
issues.description: POST /api/v1/auth/login should return 400 on empty body, but returns 503.

issues.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
issues.description: No CSP header present on main domain.

issues.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
issues.description: No CSP header present on app domain.

issues.title: API documentation exposed at /api-docs
issues.description: Swagger UI accessible at /api-docs on production domain.

issues.title: API documentation exposed at /api-docs
issues.description: Swagger UI accessible at /api-docs on production app domain.

issues.description: API index/version endpoint returns content at /api/v1.

issues.description: API index/version endpoint returns content at /api/v1.
issues.evidence: curl https://app.thenewfuse.com/api/v1 returns 503 page but endpoint responds
